session_note: The 109th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session (2026), adjourned sine die on 2026-04-17 (legislative Day 60), ending the 2025-2026 biennium; the legislature's own homepage confirms 'The Legislature has adjourned SINE DIE.' Nebraska bills carry over from the 1st Session (2025) to the 2nd Session (2026) of the same biennium, but nothing carries past this sine die into a future biennium, so every bill in this packet has a true final 2026 disposition and none should be 'carried_over'.
